content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification:** deviation (walk-away territory), targeted at the **preferred** level.

- **Responsive locations reviewed:** §7.2 (p0026 — disclose-and-match before engaging another provider), §12.3 (p0044 — favourable no-exclusivity acknowledgement), §2.1 (take-or-pay minimum — separate rule), §12.4 second instance (Customer non-compete — separate rule), plus all "exclusive" hits (licence, forum, remedies), none of which bind our sourcing freedom.
- **Why it fails:** §7.2 makes disclosure and matching of a competing offer a precondition to engaging another provider — a right of first refusal functioning as de facto exclusivity on Customer, with no product-category limit, no 12-month cap and no automatic performance-based exit, running the full three-year term.
- **Cure:** one surgical replacement of the offending sentence with an express statement that we may engage other providers and have no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation, aligning §7.2 with §12.3 and leaving all other fee terms untouched.
